# Binance Plans Pricing

Binance does not charge for API access itself; commercial pricing is expressed as spot/futures trading commissions and a tiered VIP fee schedule based on 30-day trading volume and BNB holdings. API connectivity, market data, and WebSocket streams are provided at no cost to authenticated users; revenue is captured per-trade. Higher VIP tiers also confer raised request weight ceilings.

Binance Plans Pricing is the machine-readable pricing-plan profile for [Binance](https://apis.io/providers/binance/) on the [APIs.io](https://apis.io/) network, in the [API Commons Plans](https://apicommons.org/) shape.

It defines 4 plans, covering freemium, usage-based, tiered, and enterprise tiers, with named plans including *API Access (No Fee)*, *Spot Trading - Regular User*, *Spot Trading - VIP Tiers*, *Institutional / Broker*.

This profile was written by API Evangelist and has not been verified against a page the provider published; treat every figure as unconfirmed until a dated transcription replaces it.

Tagged areas include Cryptocurrency, Exchange, Trading, Blockchain, and Finance.

### Plans

API Access (No Fee) freemium

Free programmatic access to Binance's REST and WebSocket APIs for any authenticated account. Trading is what is billed, not connectivity.

API connectivity (request · usage) 0.00 USD

Market data (REST + WebSocket) (request · usage) 0.00 USD

- Spot Trading API
- USD-S Margined Futures API
- COIN-M Futures API
- European Options API
- Margin Trading API
- Wallet API
- WebSocket Streams
- Sandbox / Spot Testnet

Spot Trading - Regular User usage-based

Default maker/taker commission for accounts under VIP 1 thresholds (less than $1M 30-day spot volume). BNB holders receive a 25% discount when paying fees in BNB.

Maker fee (transaction · usage) 0.1000% USD

Taker fee (transaction · usage) 0.1000% USD

BNB fee discount (transaction · usage) -25% when paid in BNB USD

- Spot Trading
- Margin Trading
- Convert
- Copy Trading
- Trading Bots

Spot Trading - VIP Tiers tiered

Volume-discounted maker/taker fees for accounts that meet 30-day trading volume and BNB balance thresholds. VIP status applies universally across Binance products.

VIP 1 maker / taker (>= $1M volume, >= 5 BNB) (transaction · usage) 0.0900% / 0.1000% USD

VIP 3 maker / taker (>= $20M volume, >= 100 BNB) (transaction · usage) 0.0400% / 0.0600% USD

VIP 5 maker / taker (>= $150M volume, >= 1000 BNB) (transaction · usage) 0.0250% / 0.0310% USD

VIP 9 maker / taker (>= $4B volume, >= 5500 BNB) (transaction · usage) 0.0110% / 0.0230% USD

- Reduced Spot/Margin/Convert/Copy/Bot fees
- Higher API request weight ceilings at higher VIP tiers
- Priority customer support at upper tiers

Institutional / Broker enterprise

Negotiated fee schedules for institutional, market maker, broker, and Binance Link partners. Pricing and rebates negotiated per relationship.

Institutional fees (transaction · usage) contact sales USD

- Binance Link / Broker Program
- Market Maker Program
- Liquidity Provider rebates
- Sub-account hierarchy
- Dedicated relationship management
